items.title: Arrests planned when ISIS-linked families land in Australia
items.description: Flights have been booked for families linked to Islamic State fighters returning from Syria to Australia, with women in the group facing arrest and investigation when they touch down.

items.title: Cancellation 'disaster' for business that expected Inland Rail for 25 years
items.description: Regional communities from Queensland to Victoria react after the major federal rail project was axed overnight.

items.title: Man arrested after wearing swastika shirt outside royal commission
items.description: A man wearing a T-shirt with a swastika was initially moved on by police outside the royal commission into antisemitism in Sydney, before later being arrested.

items.title: Live: Trump announces pause to Strait of Hormuz operation, Israel warns of imminent strikes on Lebanon
items.description: Israel issues urgent evacuation orders for villages in Lebanon, accusing Hezbollah of violating the ceasefire. Meanwhile, Donald Trump says Project Freedom will pause to try to get a peace deal signed with Iran. Follow live.

items.title: Finnish defence giant has tech 'Australia might be interested in'
items.description: The company that provides much of Australia's satellite surveillance for real-time disaster management may also soon be sharing its defence technology, as Finland becomes the latest European country to seek closer ties on security.

items.title: Australia gives $30m to Fiji to help fuel prices in Pacific nation
items.description: The Australian government says the funding will help Fiji combat rising fuel prices and support its role as a regional fuel hub.

items.title: River camp residents ask people 'not to judge' them after baby's death
items.description: Long-term campers set up at the base of a levee popular with walkers are asking people to have an "open mind" about why they are there, saying many have nowhere else to go.

items.title: Couple sues Monash IVF for negligence over embryo mix-up
items.description: A couple is suing fertility giant Monash IVF for negligence over an embryo mix-up at its Brisbane clinic discovered last year.

items.title: Snow, rain, icy winds forecast as polar blast hits south-east Australia
items.description: A wintry mix of snow, icy temperatures, and showers is set to hit Australia's south-east, bringing a sharp end to the recent run of warm autumn weather.

items.title: One Nation corflutes backing Ben Roberts-Smith spark legal warning
items.description: One Nation election advertising stating the party's support for Ben Roberts-Smith, who is charged with carrying out war crimes in Afghanistan, has legal experts worried.

items.title: Fire destroys SES headquarters and new $270K flood rescue vehicle
items.description: The SES is mopping up after a fire ripped through its Central Coast headquarters, destroying millions of dollars' worth of specialist equipment.

items.title: Cruise of a lifetime becomes nightmare after hantavirus outbreak
items.description: It was meant to be the journey of a lifetime for Boston travel influencer Jake Rosmarin, crossing the south Atlantic Ocean on the MV Hondius, but the trip has turned into a nightmare after three people died in a hantavirus outbreak.

items.title: Child protection workers stood down over Kumanjayi Little Baby
items.description: Three child protection workers have been stood down and a department-wide review ordered over its handling of Kumanjayi Little Baby's circumstances before her alleged murder.

items.title: Ban on Craig Silvey's books hardened in public schools after guilty plea
items.description: WA Education Minister Sabine Winton confirms a temporary ban on Silvey's books being used as texts in public schools will now be made permanent.

items.title: How a flamboyant thief quietly pulled off an extraordinary coin heist
items.description: David Gee pulled off one of the most baroque and ambitious coin heists in Australian history, nicking precious coins from the special collections of the nation's oldest library without anybody noticing.

items.title: The ideal age to start swimming lessons for your child
items.description: Swimming ability is declining in Australia, and experts say knowing the right age to enrol your children in lessons — as well as what to do if you can't access them — is key to improving water safety.

items.title: More than 500 turtles discovered on the outskirts of far west NSW town
items.description: Hundreds of turtles are thriving near an outback NSW town, only months after the lake where they live was on the verge of drying up.

items.title: How climbing is trying to remain inclusive after IOC's trans ban
items.description: For Phoebe and Luce, joining an LGBTQI+ social climbing group was transformative. But as a trans woman and non-binary person, they have faced barriers to participating in elite competition and are calling for change.

items.title: Police chief moves to reassure community after another Melbourne business set alight
items.description: Police are unable to say whether an arson attack at a Port Melbourne car dealership is linked to escalating firebombings and kidnappings.

items.title: Police officers accused of alleged assault of mentally ill prisoner
items.description: Two Queensland police officers are contesting the charges that relate to a 2024 incident at a regional watch house, arguing that investigators added things to the alleged victim's statement that he never said.

items.title: 'Justice is served': Afghan women's footballers react to FIFA ruling
items.description: A FIFA rule change has allowed the Afghan women's football team to compete in official internationals for the first time since the Taliban took over in 2021. Mina Ahmadi says the victory is a "very emotional" one for the team.

items.title: 'I don't owe LIV anything': SA premier on struggling golf league's Adelaide future
items.description: As LIV Golf tries to plug the funding hole left by Saudi Arabia, Peter Malinauskas says he would welcome the tour back to Adelaide, but only "if it stacks up for us".

items.title: Car locks disabled at hospital as signal interference sparks security concern
items.description: Radio interference from nearby cranes is identified as the reason visitors to Bunbury Hospital have been unable to lock their cars.

items.title: Nidhi fought for 10 years to get on the NDIS. The new cuts have left her 'in limbo'
items.description: Nidhi Shekaran is one of thousands of NDIS participants waiting to learn if their services will be impacted as part of sweeping government reforms to the scheme.

items.title: NT budget faces criticism over cuts and lack of cost of living relief
items.description: The Country Liberal Party's second NT budget has received a lukewarm response from civil society groups, with advocates criticising funding cuts and a "missed opportunity" to support Territorians.
